name: Fester, Mass
target: one creature/level, no two more than 30 feet apart
summary: Multiple foes resist healing with spell resistance 12 + caster level and halve healing that ignores spell resistance; a successful Fortitude save reduces duration to 1 round.
description: This functions as fester, except it affects multiple foes. Each target gains spell resistance equal to 12 + your caster level against effects that restore hit points or grant temporary hit points, and healing that ignores spell resistance is halved. A successful Fortitude save reduces the duration to 1 round.
